name: 14_amendment
description: Favourable amendments: S1 indexes θ 80,000 → 82,400 and lowers the cap 2.5 → 2.4 (attestor-signed, nonce 1); a proof built against the old terms commitment is InvalidProof, the next report pays 4% of income above the new θ. S2 has already paid 250 USDC per unit when its cap is lowered to 2.0 × 105 = 210: the effective cap is max(cap, paid) (no underflow) and a keeper's retire_if_capped retires the series. Reverts: NotIssuer, InvalidAttestorSignature, UnfavourableAmendment (cap up / below bounds), AmendmentAfterTerminal.

config.chainDomainNote: Bid/ask commitments, signed messages and the deployment domain depend on chain-specific wallet bytes and chain id; harnesses recompute them from the plaintext fields here (salts, prices, quantities, periods, nonces, prior/income commitments, liquidity flags) and sign with the keys derived from `keys[*].seed`. Amounts, periods and ledger values are chain-independent.
